description: Tata Electronics is developing a Rs 91,000-crore semiconductor fab at Gujarat's Dholera, while Micron’s Sanand unit involves Rs 13,000 cr, strengthening the state’s bid to become India’s chip hub.
body_lead: Gujarat is reshaping its economic roadmap, moving beyond traditional manufacturing and heavy industry to place artificial intelligence (AI), semiconductors and green energy at the core of its future growth. Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel also unveiled an ambitious industrial roadmap last month — predicting that the western state would become a $3.5 trillion economy by 2047.
